name: ui11_21_do_win_proc_message_takes_the_window
description: Conformance test 21: DoWinProcMessage gets the WINDOW as arg1, not the message (6.5). A win proc must be able to GetParam on its first argument and reach the dialog's properties (0xEA9F13C0 for the advice). A shim that passes the message instead fails this. [choice] the deliver op names its window argument separately from the message so the swap cannot be expressed.
